The 9 December 2003 capture of the swccgpc.com 2003 events list names [[Jon Westergard]] and [[Brandon Pahl]] together as qualifiers. It does not label a 1st or a 2nd. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 19:55, 17 November 2026 (UTC)

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used (all Internet Archive captures of swccgpc.com, opened and checked):
* https://web.archive.org/web/20040622063805/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/mysticvisions05012003.htm (Michael Carr's announcement, 1 May 2003)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20031229115404/http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/may03archives.htm (1 May 2003 news post)
=== Build notes ===
* The announcement calls Carr's role hosting the convention; the events list, cited here and on [[Michael Carr]], names him as tournament director of the Open (from the events list).
* Left out: Carr's personal email address (PayPal and contact address in the announcement), and his signature line as "Lancaster, PA Raw Deal Manager" (another game).
=== Missing data ===
* No results beyond the two Day 2 qualifiers, and none for the Friday four-round event.
